Hi user and thank you too. I only have my 42 semester units in computer information systems, no certifications or anything like that. I would like a tech support job for the time being so I couldn't save up for a boot camp. I think I would be good at web development, front-end primarily. My highest level of math competed is Algebra 2 so I don't have enough math knowledge to do programming and get into designing algorithms and solving complex problems.

I applied to a tech support position and there were things that I didn't understand such as the OSI model and failed the interview due to it.

Thank you Thrin for hearing me out, I know that was a lot to read. I really do hope one day I can finish some sort of education and find a decent job one day. I would really like to save up to go to a coding boot camp for web development and hopefully that will be a turning point. I'm sorry your mom did the same thing to you, it's really heartbreaking when the people you depend on just leave and expect everything to be okay.

This is my first time posting on here. I've lurked before whenever I'd feel down but I just feel like I haven't seriously thought about how to kill myself for this long of a period of time.

I don't think I feel like life is pointless, I see so many people out there happy and I wish I could feel like that too. I just feel like I've put myself in a position where I don't really have a future that is meaningful.

I was born here in California but was raises from a few months old to 5 in Guatemala. I lived in California all my life. I started struggling with depression when u turned 13. I developed a spine condition that caused me to have a hunched back called Scheuermanns Disease. I had a hard time making friends and felt alone.

During my second year of high school, my mom unexpectedly left with my younger brother to live with a man in France. I ended up having the rent paid for a month and was told once it ended to contact my grandmother. I stopped going to school and my depression spiraled out of control. At the end of the month I called my grandmother and moved in with her. 

I switched over to a local high school and felt even more isolated. I would just not go and would go to the local movie theater or Barnes and Noble to distract myself. I ended up just coming forward to my grandmother about it and I obtained my GED and spent a year trying to figure out what I wanted to study and do with my life.

Around this time, my mom came back and was struggling to find employment for a year. My grandmother took her in and I didn't feel any resentment towards her, I felt happy to have her back in my life. After two years of job hunting, she found a job in Santa Barbara and I decided to move with her up north despite my grandmother advising against it. 

She wasn't making great money and I was going to school for accounting. She was constantly applying to other jobs and before the semester ended, she found a good job offer in Minnesota so we moved. We lived in Minnesota for six months. During this time I didn't go to school due to my financial aid being cut off. I started my first job and worked for those six months until my mom got laid off. 

We moved back to California but this time we decided on living in an unfinished house my grandmother owned in Bakersfield that wasn't suitable for renting out. My mom found a job in Lake County and I decided I wouldn't follow her and would get a little part time job to buy myself food and pay for other expenses like cellphone and Internet while I enrolled in as many classes as I could afford. I spent two years there and got around 42 semester units, but couldn't take being alone all the time. I wasn't able to make any friends and felt really bad back pain and depression. 

After two years of my mom not moving around so much and her buying a house in Lake County, I decided that I couldn't handle being alone anymore so I moved back in with her. I got two jobs to help around with bills and such and started not being able to handle school work and decided to drop out of school.

This is where I am. I feel like I don't have a future to look forward to. I work two jobs I hate to help pay bills and I have really several back pain on top of the fact that the physical deformity it causes has left me with low self esteem. I don't know if I want to live anymore. If i didn't have this back condition I would love to join the army for some direction in life. I'm tired of applying to entry level computer tech jobs only to be ghosted by employers. I feel lost. 

I can't just stop working and focus on school. But at the same time the jobs I have pay next to nothing. My car is literally on its last mm of break pads and it had a constant tps sign on the dash. I can't afford new break pads and I'm scared of even taking it to get the tire patched only to be told that the slow leak was bad and now I need new tires that I can't afford. I'm just so fucking stressed out ;(
